title: Flip Garden
text: Flip Garden turns market making on Monad into a garden you can watch grow.

title: The problem
text: Order books move several times a second. Placing a limit order is easy. Knowing what it really earned, after fills, fees and gas, is hard.

title: Plant
text: On Kuru, a flip order places the opposite order by itself when it fills. Flip Garden turns a few dollars into flip orders, signed with one passkey.

title: Grow
text: Every fill makes a plant grow. A completed round trip bears fruit.

title: The garden and the ledger
text: Each order is a plot in a 3D garden, and the ledger checks every number against the chain, losses as clearly as gains.

title: The Gardener
text: The Gardener agent tends the garden inside a mandate you confirm once, and re-places bids the market has left behind.

title: Hedge
text: Filled bids leave you holding MON. A small short on Perpl hedges it, paid in AUSD.

title: Deposit from any chain
text: Money comes in from five chains through Aurora, and a wallet's full history is read through Envio.

title: Why Monad
text: Monad's speed, and fees of a fraction of a cent, make a few dollars of orders worth tending. Flip Garden. Plant, grow, hedge, and read the ledger.
